mechanisms.name: The vocal bench has observer and acoustic-scale limits
mechanisms.classification: Overstrong diagnosis and nonphysical normalization at a demonstration boundary
mechanisms.observed_mechanism: The bench claims that equal-sounding comparison buttons prove the listening path is defective and the bench is fine. mechanisms.name: A bounded keyword failure was recorded as a certified no-path result
mechanisms.classification: Certificate exceeds its exact search predicate
mechanisms.observed_mechanism: fabric_ask.walk ranks matching words, limits candidates to12, uses rarity/overlap thresholds and chooses prewritten entries or paired clauses. ask may fall through to other mechanisms after a turn-taking exception, offers nearest knowledge, and eventually writes VERDICT: no path — certified by deterministic walk to the white sheet. The sentence stager enumerates n(n+1)^n candidates but only for its capped first groups; it does disclose omitted groups, which is a useful limit to preserve.
mechanisms.evidence_limits: Failure of this selected representation, limited pool and authored rules does not establish no answer, no knowledge, no physical relation or no possible speech. Four staged groups imply2500 candidates; eight imply344373768 by the printed algorithm. This exact arithmetic is not a measurement of Task1434 or the current substrate.
mechanisms.replacement: Scope certificates to the exact attempted operation, complete searched domain and actual stop condition. Preserve unknowns and budget refusals without promoting them into universal negative facts. Do not make a failure green through fallbacks or a larger arbitrary work limit.
